exposure: antibiotic regimen (single oral azithromycin, intravenous ampicillin, oral amoxicillin) for PPROM
outcome: changes in vaginal Lactobacillus spp. levels
cohort: Singleton pregnancies managed with prophylactic antibiotics for preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) at less than 36 weeks of gestation were included.
finding: The antibiotic regimen for PPROM led to an increase in vaginal Ureaplasma levels in 75% of those who completed treatment and a decrease in Lactobacillus spp. in almost all cases, suggesting it may not be effective against Ureaplasma or Mycoplasma.
